title: PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) Member Terms: Payment Arrangement History and Alert Warning Days
content:
**Term 1.** For the reset of a PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) low-balance alert amount, where a payment arrangement of the member was billed back for default in the twenty-four-month window, the warning days are increased by 2; where none was billed back for default in that window but an installment of one was missed in it, they are increased by 1; with neither they are not increased for arrangements.

**Term 2.** The member's arrangements are those on Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements): an unbilled balance billed back for default, and missed installments, as the arrangement records of the member show them by their entry date. A window of a stated number of months takes the records dated after the same day of the month that many months before the current date, through the current date.

**Illustrations (hypothetical).**

| Default billed back in the window | Installment missed in the window | Warning days |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes or no | increased by 2 |
| no | yes | increased by 1 |
| no | no | not increased for arrangements |

A member whose arrangement was billed back for default twenty months ago is in the first row; a member who missed two installments eight months ago on an arrangement that was later completed is in the second row.
